text:
julia: small thread — noticed a perf regression after last autotune cycle. p50 increased ~12% for seq_len>=1024 on gpus in eu-west-1.

owen: did you grab a trace? link: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/1974012345

julia: yeah — attached flame showed lots of tiny launches. compute is fine but launch overhead dominates for these longseq batches. past autotuner picks a kernel optimized for throughput but with higher per-launch setup.

priya: hmm could this be kv-cache fragmentation? we recently enabled async-kv-warmup on that fleet.

julia: i checked — KV hit-rate actually improved (cache hit ~92%), but when cache warms we see more split fragments leading to smaller effective batch shapes. numbers:
```
baseline (old autotune): launch_ms=0.8 compute_ms=6.9 total_ms=7.7
new autotune pick:     launch_ms=1.7 compute_ms=5.8 total_ms=7.5
prod observed (mixed): launch_ms=2.3 compute_ms=6.0 total_ms=8.3
```

julia: so compute got faster but launch went up and batching scheduler didn't collapse shapes because of continuous batching policy producing many tiny groups.

owen: interesting. autotuner picks kernel A for seq>=512 on ampere which has dense kernel but longer init. kernel B has shorter launch but worse compute for large seq.

priya: can we have autotuner consider expected batch-shape distribution (including scheduler skew) not just raw seq hist? maybe add a "launch_penalty" term and weight by observed tiny-batch fraction.

owen: yes — quick patch idea:
```
# autotune config tweak
score = throughput - alpha*launch_ms - beta*tail_variance
# alpha tuned per-hw
```

julia: i prototyped alpha=0.5 and ran a canary: total_ms dropped from 8.3 -> 7.1 for the affected model. would like to roll to the rest of eu-west.

priya: +1. can we add a regression test that simulates continuous-batching with kv-warmup to avoid this surprising flip?

julia: scheduled a small rollout: canary 2 hosts -> 10% -> 50%. I'll open a PR with config and perf dashboard snapshot.

sre-bot: :warning: Deploy scheduled: canary on eu-west-1 - check logs /metrics @julia @owen

owen: also noted we should surface "launch_ms" in console per-model so product teams can see these tradeoffs.

julia: created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3221 (attach autotune patch + test)

priya: thanks — assigned to @julia. follow-up tomorrow to confirm rollback plan if 95th worsens.

julia: thanks all :thumbsup:
